## Supplied synthetic data and helpers

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)

# Synthetic teaching data for BIOS 6301. Not real patients.
set.seed(6301)
n <- 60
trial <- data.frame(
  id        = sprintf("P%03d", 1:n),
  arm       = rep(c("Placebo", "Treatment"), each = n / 2),
  site      = sample(1:4, n, replace = TRUE),
  age       = round(rnorm(n, 61, 9)),
  sex       = sample(c("F", "M"), n, replace = TRUE),
  weight_kg = round(rnorm(n, 82, 15), 1),
  sbp_0     = round(rnorm(n, 148, 14)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
trial$sbp_12 <- round(trial$sbp_0 -
  ifelse(trial$arm == "Treatment", rnorm(n, 14, 8), rnorm(n, 3, 8)))

# Repeated-measures version of the same cohort, for the resampling-unit demo:
# three visits per patient, a large patient-level random intercept (SD 12) and
# small within-patient noise (SD 4). Nothing is "broken" here — the data are
# simply clustered, which is what makes the row bootstrap wrong.
set.seed(2024)
patient_effect <- rnorm(n, 0, 12)
trial_long <- data.frame(
  id   = rep(trial$id, each = 3),
  arm  = rep(trial$arm, each = 3),
  week = rep(c(4, 8, 12), times = n),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
trial_long$sbp <- round(140 + rep(patient_effect, each = 3) +
  ifelse(trial_long$arm == "Treatment", -10, 0) + rnorm(n * 3, 0, 4))

theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size = 15))
gold <- "#CFAE70"

mean_diff <- function(data) {
  mean(data$sbp_12[data$arm == "Treatment"]) -
    mean(data$sbp_12[data$arm == "Placebo"])
}
```
